name: tablinks-vscode
description: Shows links between your open tabs, such as interface to implementation. Click an arrow button to go to the other tab and the exact line.

commands.title: TabLinks: Jump to a linked tab

tablinks.maxOpenDocs.description: Largest number of open tabs to analyze.

tablinks.maxSymbolsPerDoc.description: Largest number of symbols to analyze in one tab.

tablinks.links.implements.description: On a class or member, show a button to the interface, base class or overridden member.

tablinks.links.implementedBy.description: On an interface or base member, show buttons to the types and members that implement or override it.

tablinks.links.usesTypes.description: At a place that uses a type (for example new Foo()), show a button to the tab of that type.

tablinks.links.usesMembers.description: At a place that calls a member of another tab, show a button to its declaration.

tablinks.links.usedByTypes.description: On a type declaration, show buttons back to the tabs that use it.

tablinks.links.usedByMembers.description: On a method or property, show buttons back to the tabs that use it.

tablinks.clickToJump.description: Clicking at the end of a line that has an arrow button goes to the target tab. If the button has several targets, a list opens. Turn off to use the hover popup only.
